question: Saif starts from Point A and drives 31 km towards East. He then takes a right turn, drives 35 km, turns right and drives 47 km. He then takes a right turn and drives 45 km. He takes a final right turn, drives 16 km and stops at Point P. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point A again? (All turns are 90° turns only unless specified.)
solution:
Given:

 
• Saif starts from Point A and drives 31 km towards East.
 
• He then takes a right turn, drives 35 km, turns right and drives 47 km.
 
• He then takes a right turn and drives 45 km.
 
• He takes a final right turn, drives 16 km and stops at Point P.
